text: The Resilient Homes and Buildings Action Plan is a national initiative led by Toka Tū Ake EQC, the Natural Hazards Commission of Aotearoa New Zealand, aimed at strengthening the country's housing and building stock against natural hazards. The plan, spanning from 2022 to 2027, focuses on raising standards for new builds, managing risks in existing buildings, and ensuring the built environment system enables resilience. It emphasizes strong building regulation and governance, sector partnerships, and integration with climate change adaptation considerations.
